description: Remove the preview link of an R3 project: every preview link to it stops working at once (teammates' too). Only when the user asked for it, or when the preview link is what blocks an r3_project_delete the user asked for: a preview link is temporary, so it may then be removed without a separate request, and the user is told it was removed. A live project stays live; a project that was only previewed is no longer published. Deletes nothing: r3_preview_create makes a new link. A project with no open preview link is refused and left as it is. Needs the publish:preview right.
name: r3_preview_remove
